description: Closed risk taxonomy. Design constraint: every canonical term must be deterministically derivable from future physical evidence available to the M09 oracle (future ego corridor, future occupancy of other agents, minimum future distance, map geometry). This closes the v1 gap where risk_factors had derived ground truth but no direct scoring path. The parser normalizes synonyms before validation; unmapped terms are recorded in ParseResult.unmapped_terms and reported as semantic_range_failure.

terms.gt_derivation: future pedestrian trajectory intersects the ego corridor
adjacent-lane vehicle future trajectory enters the ego corridor (cut-in)
lead vehicle future speed decreases below current ego speed while in ego corridor
any future occupancy (vehicle, bicycle, pedestrian) intersects the ego corridor
future minimum distance to the lead object falls below a preregistered threshold
static object inside or adjacent to the ego corridor with zero future velocity
low lead speed with multiple vehicles queued ahead in the ego corridor
oncoming vehicle within interaction range in the opposing lane relative to ego future path
